title: Anchored masonry veneer.
officialText:
Anchored masonry veneer shall comply with the provisions of Sections 1405.6, 1405.7, 1405.8,
and 1405.9 and Sections 6.1 and 6.2 of TMS 402/ACI 530/ASCE 5.
